hypotheses.reasoning: account-svc v1.5.0 rolled out at 17:41:18 and was ready by 17:41:51. Less than 2 minutes later, account-svc started throwing an unhandled TypeError in POST /login (reading 'currency' of undefined at user-formatter.ts:132). Every one of these errors is tagged [v1.5.0]. edge-proxy 500s (#104, #128, #152, #165) all point back to account-svc. accounts-db shows only routine vacuum and checkpoint lines, and auth-svc, session-cache and audit-consumer log no warnings or errors. Only some logins fail, which fits a code path in the new formatter that breaks for users whose profile has no currency object.
Some user records might be missing a currency/profile field. But the failures only started after the v1.5.0 deploy, so even if such records exist, the release is what made them fatal.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll account-svc back to v1.4.9. Then fix user-formatter.ts:132 in v1.5.0 so it handles a missing currency field (optional chaining or a default value), and add a test for users who don't have that field before redeploying.
